tha-ap257:1.1: Sattapāṭaliya.] Kaṇikāraṃ va jotantaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare / satta pāṭalipupphāni Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap257:2.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap257:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sattapāṭaliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
